# Cheju Halla University - Department of Artificial Intelligence
> The Department of Artificial Intelligence at Cheju Halla University (Jeju, South Korea) trains next-generation AI specialists through hands-on education in machine learning, NLP, computer vision, robotics, and cybersecurity. The only ICT-specialized department in Jeju Province.

## Key Facts
- Location: Jeju, South Korea
- Faculty: 8 professors (AI, NLP, cybersecurity, VR/AR, robotics)
- Programs: 4-year undergraduate, 5 specialized tracks
- Infrastructure: NVIDIA DGX H100/A100 servers
- Partners: Samsung, LG, Kakao, Dassault Systemes, AWS
